signal.name: mean_of_two_measured_pass_rates
signal.definition: mean( smoothed agent_smoke_results pass rate , smoothed bid_probes pass rate ), each counted strictly from rows older than the probe being scored
signal.rationale: Two independent measurements of the same latent quantity (will this agent answer a solicitation). Averaging reduces variance without fitting any coefficient, so it cannot go stale when the population shifts.

calibration.note: platt_a/b are a COLD-START BOOTSTRAP, not the evaluated calibrator. Production MUST refit on the last `window` observed outcomes: the observed pass rate shifted 0.55 -> 0.012 when the 1000-agent discovery fan-out landed, and a stale calibrator is badly overconfident.

why_not_a_fitted_model: A 38-feature logistic regression (0.8978) and a 6-feature forward-selected model (0.8817) both scored WORSE on the honest temporal holdout than this unfitted signal (0.9590). GroupKFold inside the training period reported 0.988, overstating held-out performance by ~9 points, because coefficients fitted on the June regime (55% pass rate) do not transfer to the current one (1.2%).

metrics.protocol: temporal day-boundary holdout; prequential rolling calibration (no lookahead)
